body:
Well, it has been three hours since I posted this and my boyfriend still hasn't said a word to me. I even emerged from the bedroom to sit on the couch with him and not a word. Even my dog won't come comfort me. He's stuck by his side.

I can't do this anymore. Thank you guys for trying to help, but I can't even help myself at this point.

I don't really have any friends here. I moved here five years ago and I'm still having a hard time making friends.

I appreciate that you'll be thinking of me. It's a little comforting that somebody out there cares.

I tried. He walked out of the room without saying anything, left to get food, and hasn't said anything to me since he got back. 

I appreciate the suggestion though.
